Deep-navy shadow behind the girder layers, never pure black. No text, no UI elements. Darks stay a lifted deep navy, never pure black; no letterbox bars, no frame or border around the picture. Every player craft faces right: nose pointing to the right, engines and exhaust on the left. Enemy bullets are round glowing orbs with bright cores and dark rims.
